OncallBot: INCIDENT ALERT: P1 — spike in 5xx rate for /v1/generate (eu region). Pager lists primary=Maya, secondary=Sam. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/pg-5xx
Maya: I just got the page. I'm on a train (inbound), ETA ~40m. Can Sam take primary for the next ~1h? Priya can shadow. :plane:
Sam: I see the page. I can take primary for 90m. Switching now. Maya, drop any quick notes you want me to know. :thumbsup:
Maya: handing off — quick checklist completed:
- added incident channel summary with first seen and symptoms
- grabbed recent logs + sample request ids and pinned them
- noted a recent rollout to eu-gpu-pool-02 ~10m before spike
Pinned runbook and traces.
Maya: logs snippet for quick context:
```
[2026-03-15T02:34:12Z] svc-inference eu-gpu-02 500 GET /v1/generate id=abc123
[2026-03-15T02:34:13Z] kv-cache miss for id=abc123
```
Sam: thanks — running the runbook steps now: pool health -> routing -> autoscaler. If pool unhealthy, we'll fallback to model-variant: small-quantized-v1.
Sam: quick cluster check: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-eu --selector=svc=inference` — seeing 3/5 ready on eu-gpu-02.
Sam: scaling eu-gpu-02 pool +2 replicas and enabling burst capacity. Also preparing to rollback the last canary to reduce pressure: `redwood deploy rollback --target eu-gpu-02 --since 10m`
Priya: shadowing — I'll own external comms and the support queue so Maya/Sam can focus on infra. Watching error budget and SLOs.
DeployBot: NOTE: scheduled infra rollout (region: eu) is queued in ~18m window. If not aborted, it may overlap with mitigation. To cancel: `deployctl abort 78910`.
Maya: updated PagerDuty primary to Sam and added handoff notes in Ops doc (link pinned). Leaving my mobile for urgent SMS.
OncallBot: ACTION: Primary reassigned -> Sam. Secondary set -> Priya. Escalation timers reset.
Sam: acknowledged. Monitoring dashboards (latency, 5xx, model throughput). I'll post updates every 10m or on notable changes.
Priya: prepping a short status-page blurb if 5xx stays >2% for 15m. Also will triage any priority support tickets.
Maya: leaving now — reachable by SMS if needed. Good luck team.
Sam: taking control — if errors don't reduce in 10m I'll proceed with rollback and remove traffic from eu-gpu-02.
OncallBot: INCIDENT status -> INVESTIGATING. Current 5xx rate 4.2% (baseline ~0.1%). Ticket INC-2026-349 created. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-349
Sam: UPDATE: after scaling and aborting queued rollout, 5xx rate dropped to 0.9%. Continued monitoring.
Priya: watching external metrics and support queue. I'll escalate to comms if we see a regression.
Maya: back online in ~1h. Thanks all :thumbsup:
